posts.text: Random draw doubles disc golf at my house Saturday night 9/19/26...$7 gets lights for your discs and entry into 7 DIFFERENT payouts...(lottery is $131+/ mini ace is $75)...36 holes of PAR-2 and 9 holes of PAR-3 mini = 45 total holes...Be registered by 7:30pm....Say "IN" below for all who will attend...608 Woodford Street 22401...
Its a long shot but if anyone finds an uninked Candace Burge essence with a purple rim in the Curtis park lost and found, please let me know. Thanks!

Come see us on Saturday night 9-19 at Cider Lab by Spotsylvania Courthouse during the SPAM event. We will be there from 630-9pm with a few baskets for games, slot shot, and cornhole. There is also a raffle drawing for some passes to TPWDGC(be sure to see previous posts on how to buy in). @[100077682637530:2048:Cider lab - Spotsylvania] has great food as well as ciders. Dont have to be a player of the event to enjoy the fun. Bring your family and I hope to see you all there.
